critical_code_review_comments: ai_moderator.py: heuristic + LLM separation is clean; fail-OPEN throughout (LLM error → allow) is the right call for chat. WARN path correctly notifies user privately AND still broadcasts. BLOCK path correctly drops the message + notifies sender only.

ad_spend.py: idempotent upsert via (platform, campaign_id, date) compound key is correct. Seed uses random.Random(20260426) for deterministic regen. ROAS join via transactions.external_attribution=true is the right plumbing. Consider adding a Mongo index hint on (platform, campaign_id, date) for production scale, but not blocking for a few thousand rows.
admin.py refire-emails: maker grouping by slug is correct. failed[] surfaces error string per kind so MailerSend 429 quota errors will be visible to the operator. Good.
settings.py SettingsPatch: adding ai_moderator_enabled to model_dump(exclude_unset=True) means PATCH semantics are preserved correctly.

Minor: ad_spend.py:212 query uses {'$or': [{'campaign_id': {'$regex': '^demo-'}}], 'date': ...} — the $or wrapper around a single condition is redundant. Could simplify to {'campaign_id': {'$regex': '^demo-'}, 'date': ...}.
